title: Can't load/save setting on SD Card
symptom: User changed from Sony Z5C with Android 7.1 to Samsung XCover 4S with Android Pie. They cannot load old settings and after saving to SD Card, xDrip says settings saved in SDCard Downloads but the folder cannot be found. They created a Downloads folder on the SD Card but still nothing.
cause: xDrip stores everything to integrated memory, but names it SD Card.
fix: Files are found on internal memory in Folder Download/xDrip-export.
evidence_quote: The point is, that xDrip stores everything to integrated memory, but names it SD Card.
